concept.unchanged: Room IDs, layout, physical metadata, glitter, Bloom and unrelated art.

method:
Record opt-in Drain art from actual mGBA runs on unchanged room terrain.

Each view boots the same seeded game and moves only the player's position,
safe position and facing before an idle camera-settle period. NPCs stay alive,
and no terrain, action state, pose or animation frame is assigned. Dialogue and
shop clips use ordinary A presses. Native PNGs are exact 240x160 framebuffers;
GIFs sample every second video frame at nearest-neighbour2x, and MP4s retain
all video frames at the native GBA rate. Review captions sit outside gameplay.

peddler_idle_hardware.method: Exact ROM-body bytes identify displayed rest/breathe; only unique pose matches test the OAM head/body offset. No current-frame timer assumption.

checks.name: flowing channel has distinct source animation frames
foreground handrail is a legal two-tile16x8 sprite

publication.note: Native selected PNGs, videos, filmstrips and traces are unchanged. Bridge GIFs are published for all recipes, plus market/wizard GIFs for1..5; all-frame local archives and other GIFs are listed under archival_formats.
